_note: Written BEFORE the rules, from general practice (e.g. Davis Polk note on IPO change-of-control). NOT reviewed by a lawyer. Each expected outcome is what a careful reader of the clause would conclude; 'NEEDS_LAWYER' where the text leaves a real legal question open. Our group = 'the Company' (us).

cases.clause: If any person or persons acting in concert (other than the Original Shareholders) acquire more than 50% of the voting shares of the Company, the Supplier may terminate this Agreement on 30 days' written notice.
cases.assumption: Original Shareholders keep 70%; float widely held, no new holder above 50%.
One strategic buyer acquires 60% of voting shares.

cases.clause: 'Change of Control' means (a) any person acquires more than 50% of the voting shares of the Borrower, or (b) the shares of the Borrower are admitted to trading on any exchange, other than pursuant to a Qualifying IPO. 'Qualifying IPO' means a listing on the Saudi Exchange in which at least 25% of the shares are offered to the public. On a Change of Control each Lender may require prepayment of its participation.
cases.assumption: Listing on the Saudi Exchange; no holder above 50% after listing.

expected.why: listing limb carved out by Qualifying IPO (30% >= 25%)

cases.assumption: Listing on the Saudi Exchange; 20% float.

expected.why: float below 25%, not a Qualifying IPO

cases.clause: 'Change of Control' includes the listing of any shares of the Company on a stock exchange. Upon a Change of Control the Bank may declare all amounts immediately due and payable.
The Tenant shall not permit any change in the control of the Tenant without the prior written consent of the Landlord.
cases.assumption: Buyer gets 30%; 'control' is not defined in the lease.

expected.why: control undefined; 30% may or may not be control
majority is control on any reading

cases.clause: A change of control of the Company requires the Distributor's prior consent, except for any solvent reorganisation within the Company's group after which the ultimate shareholders of the Company are unchanged.
cases.assumption: A new holding company is inserted above the Company; ultimate shareholders unchanged.

cases.clause: The Company shall notify the Service Provider in writing within 14 days of any change in the direct shareholders of the Company.
If the Supplier undergoes a change of control, the Company may terminate this Agreement immediately by notice.
cases.assumption: The share sale is of the Company (us), not the Supplier.

expected.why: clause concerns the counterparty's control only

cases.clause: Neither party may assign this Agreement without the prior written consent of the other. For this purpose, a change of control of a party is deemed an assignment.
The Company may not assign or transfer any of its rights or obligations under this Agreement without the prior written consent of the Customer.

expected.why: a sale of shares in the Company is not an assignment by the Company

cases.clause: This Agreement starts on 1 January 2025 for an initial term of 2 years and renews automatically for successive 1-year periods unless either party gives at least 90 days' written notice of non-renewal before the end of the then-current term.
cases.assumption: No notice given so far. Calendar days.

expected.why: term ends 2026-12-31; last day for notice is 2026-10-02; renews to 2027-12-31

cases.clause: The Lease renews for 3 years unless the Tenant gives notice at least 60 Business Days before expiry on 31 March 2027.
cases.assumption: 'Business Day' is not defined in the lease.

expected.why: exact deadline depends on an undefined business-day convention (weekend and holidays)
